about: Layout 3b, the build target of ADR-0010 (2026-10-17): the solver's case 3 (PSU flat, exits free) with the field rail shifted to x 40-324 and two upper-left grommets, so every cable group has a duct path. Centres in mm (x front 0 to back 457, y left 0 to right 330); rot 1 = the block's long side runs along y. Score with layout_study.Score('B', place) after setting Exits to 'exits' and renaming the SHIELD-UL net to SHIELD-ULM. Rescored 2026-10-18 (issue #158): FB1 is a 12-way, so the fuse rail (RFB) is 60 mm longer and the 5 V PSU (PS5) moved to the 24 V row against the back ring, with the lower left grommet (LL) moved from x 292 to 390 past the fuse rail's end; the 2026-10-17 layout scored 34892. Expected wire: 35929 conductor-mm (hand layout 57478).
